messages:
maya: Alerting eu-west rack r8 showing a sustained 95p latency bump for hosted-generation. Observed around 08:12 UTC, coincides with ToR egress queue depth rising and per-host tx_dropped. Suspect multi-tenant egress storm.
alex: Got the traces. Affected hosts: 10.5.8.12-10.5.8.16. No kernel updates in last 48h. ToR counters show VLAN 210 has heavy fanout.
deepa: Can someone run `ethtool -S eth0` and collect `tc -s qdisc` on 10.5.8.14? Also grab a 90s pcap scoped to the tenant CIDR.
maya: Ran quick ethtool: tx_dropped=1845 on 10.5.8.14. tc shows mq root with fq_codel children but some hosts report zero bytes on child qdiscs. Starting pcap now and uploading when done.
ravi: Short-term mitigations: 1) host-level tc policing by tenant CIDR, 2) ToR-level egress shaping per VLAN, 3) temporary denylist for batch jobs. Policing is fastest.
alex: I'll apply `tc filter` to match tenant CIDR -> class rate 600mbit on the affected hosts and monitor for 10m. Annotating runbook.
deepa: Also dump ToR `show interface counters` and capture flow samples. We need flow size distribution. If it's large 1-2MB writes, shaping will help.
maya: Ops-bot, open an incident and tag billing because this tenant may ask for a dedicated carveout after we suggest it.
ops-bot: Incident INC-8099 created and assigned to #eng-infra. Priority: P2. Tags: egress, noisy-tenant, billing.
alex: Shaping applied at 08:25 UTC. Immediate effect: tx_dropped on 10.5.8.14 down ~55%; 95p latency from ~410ms -> ~150ms. Monitoring.
deepa: Uploaded pcap to s3://ops/inc-8099/pcaps. Early look: many sustained large-RX flows from tenant IPs with few inter-packet gaps. Looks like bulk dataset shuffles rather than tiny RPCs.
maya: OK. Plan: close incident after 30m stable, but schedule follow-up: (1) draft eBPF ToR policer RFC, (2) recommend tenant burst carve policy + billing language, (3) add monitoring alert for VLAN-level egress skew.
alex: Agree. If this repeats we should auto-shunt non-prod tenant jobs to US spare pool as a stopgap.
maya: Thanks folks. Keep notes in the incident. I'll ping account team to notify tenant to pause heavy transfers for 1h.
